getStatColor() match arm site: Concerns/DashboardWidget.php:299-309. Only card-key->color map in the repo. RecoveryLeader hardcodes ->color('info') and extends ChartWidget, so it does not go through this method.

'UTC' and sends naive user-tz literals against UTC scanned_at. Existing accepted convention across all sibling cards.
